title: 第11章 本世子命令你立刻马上服侍我第12章 拒蛮城
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
“世子，您真决定了？”
阿三那张憨厚的脸上写满不安。
他搓着手，在屋里来回踱步，时不时往窗外瞟一眼，像是怕有人偷听。
君傲坐在太师椅上，手指有一下没一下地敲着扶手:
“决定了。我跟你们说的事，一个字都不许往外漏，听明白没有？尤其是我爹和映雪那儿，谁要是说漏嘴……”
他扫了一眼屋里几人。
阿青、阿水、阿三。
三个人到现在还不敢相信。
通过杀扶桑鬼武者来提升修为？
这话要不是从世子嘴里说出来，他们准以为这人疯了。
“世子放心，”阿三最先反应过来，郑重抱拳，“属下誓死保密。”
阿水撇了撇嘴，没说话。
阿青赶紧跟着表态。
“很好。”君傲站起身，走到窗边，看着外面渐暗的天色，“这次去南疆，阿青和阿水跟着我。阿三，你留在府里，盯着点儿。对了……”
他顿了顿，补充道:“帮我照看好怀安公主。”
“哟？”阿水挑起眉，语气里带着讥诮，“世子这是真对那位公主动心了？”
君傲转过身，咧嘴一笑:“动心谈不上。不过嘛……见色起意倒是真的。”
“无耻!”阿水啐了一口，“那我不去了。您带阿青去吧，我留在府里‘照看’公主。”
“你敢？”君傲收起笑容，“这是命令。南疆现在什么情况你们不清楚？没有你和阿青在身边，我怕鬼子没杀几个，自己先交代在那儿了。”
“我只听小姐的命令。”阿水抱着手臂，别过脸。

君傲叹了口气，从怀里掏出一枚令牌。
令牌通体乌黑，边缘镶着暗金纹路，正面刻着两个古篆大字:惊鸿。
屋里几人都是一愣。
“惊鸿令？”阿水脱口而出，“怎么在你这儿？”
“映雪给我的。”君傲把令牌往前一递，“见令如见人。阿水听令!”
阿水咬了咬嘴唇，单膝跪地:“属下在。”
君傲清了清嗓子，一本正经道:“本世子命令你，此去南疆，除保护本世子安全外，还需负责照料饮食起居，以及……”
他顿了顿，目光在阿水那张英气中带着秀丽的脸上转了转，又往下瞟了眼她紧身劲装下起伏的曲线，咽了口唾沫。
“以及本世子的生理需求。”
“你……!”阿水腾地站起来，脸涨得通红，“无耻!这个命令我不接!”
“怎么？”君傲晃了晃令牌，“惊鸿令都不放在眼里了？”
content_en:
"Your Majesty, have you really decided?"
Ah San's honest face was filled with uneasiness.
He rubbed his hands and paced back and forth in the room, glancing out of the window from time to time, as if he was afraid of someone eavesdropping.
Jun Ao sat on the Taishi chair, tapping the armrest with his fingers:
"It's decided. Don't leak a word of what I told you. Do you understand? Especially my father and Yingxue, if anyone leaks..."
He glanced at the people in the room.
Ah Qing, Ah Shui, Ah San.
The three of them still can't believe it.
Improve your cultivation by killing Fuso Onimusha?
If these words had not come out of the prince's mouth, they would have thought that this man was crazy.
"Don't worry, Your Majesty," Ah San was the first to react, clasping his fists solemnly, "I swear to the death to keep this secret."
Ah Shui curled his lips and said nothing.
Ah Qing quickly followed suit and expressed his stance.
"Very good." Jun Ao stood up, walked to the window, and looked at the darkening sky outside, "This time I go to southern Xinjiang, Ah Qing and Ah Shui will follow me. Ah San, you stay in the house and keep an eye on it. By the way..."
He paused and added: "Take good care of Princess Huai'an for me."
"Oh?" Ah Shui raised his eyebrows with a sarcastic tone, "Is the Crown Prince really attracted to that princess?"
Jun Ao turned around and grinned: "You can't talk about being tempted. But...it's true that you are attracted by sex."
"Shameless!" Ah Shui spat, "Then I won't go. You can take Ah Qing with you, and I will stay at the house to 'take care' of the princess."
"You dare?" Jun Ao put away his smile, "This is an order. You don't know what is going on in southern Xinjiang now? Without you and Ah Qing around, I'm afraid the Japs won't kill many, so I'll tell you where it is first."
"I only follow Miss's orders." Ah Shui folded his arms and turned away.
Jun Ao sighed and took out a token from his arms.
The token is completely black, with dark gold lines on the edges, and two large ancient seal characters engraved on the front: Jinghong.
Several people in the room were stunned.
"Jinghong Ling?" Ah Shui blurted out, "Why are you here?"
"Yingxue gave it to me." Jun Ao handed the token forward, "Seeing an order is like seeing a person. Ah Shui obeys the order!"
Ah Shui bit his lip and knelt on one knee: "My subordinate is here."
Jun Ao cleared his throat and said seriously: "My prince orders you that when you go to southern Xinjiang, in addition to protecting my prince's safety, you must also be responsible for taking care of your food and daily life, and..."
He paused, his eyes turning on Ah Shui's heroic and beautiful face, then glancing down at the undulating curves under her tight-fitting clothes, and swallowed.
"And this prince's physiological needs."
"You...!" Ah Shui stood up, his face flushed, "Shameless! I won't accept this order!"
"What?" Jun Ao waved the token, "You don't even care about the Jinghong Order anymore?"
